data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a net loss of GBP 4.2 million for the closed 2020 year of account, indicating adverse prior year development. This is consistent with an explicit allowance for global inflationary pressures added to gross technical provisions during the year. The gross claims development triangle is considered unreliable for underlying reserve movements due to a 100% Loss Portfolio Transfer (LPT) and 100% Group Quota Share (QS) transaction in 2022, which ceded all retrospective and prospective business for 2022 and prior years of account.
raw_causal_phrases: Due to the current global inflationary pressures, an explicit allowance for future inflation has been added to the gross technical provisions. The loading was 3.4% on gross claims reserves (with no net impact).
data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development is based on the net loss for the closed 2020 year of account, as no explicit gross prior year development figure was available. The gross claims development triangle is considered unreliable for underlying reserve movements due to the 100% Loss Portfolio Transfer (LPT) and 100% Group Quota Share (QS) transaction in 2022, which ceded all retrospective and prospective business.
